House Kit > hk_09 format and tail: houseFiles.forEach(file => { const { encoding, channels, sampleRate, bits, samples, frames } = readWav(file); expect({ file, encoding, channels, sampleRate, bits }).toEqual({ file, encoding: 1, channels: 2, sampleRate: 44100, bits: 16, }); const reachesTail = (frame: number) => Math.max(Math.abs(samples[2 * frame]), Math.abs(samples[2 * frame + 1])) >= TAIL_LEVEL; let framesAfterSound = 0; while (!reachesTail(frames - 1 - framesAfterSound)) framesAfterSound++; // The cut frame sits at -60 dBFS, and the fade pulls the last ones under it. So only about // the fade stays under -60 dBFS: more is a late cut or padding, less is a cut above -60. expect(framesAfterSound, file).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(FADE_FRAMES * 0.9); expect(framesAfterSound, file).toBeLessThanOrEqual(4410); // 100 ms: a low tom's last swings // The fade lands on 0, on the last frames only: no silence was padded after it let silentFrames = 0; while (samples[2 * (frames - 1 - silentFrames)] === 0 && samples[2 * (frames - 1 - silentFrames) + 1] === 0) { silentFrames++; } expect(silentFrames, file).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1); expect(silentFrames, file).toBeLessThan(FADE_FRAMES / 2); });
